canonical_queue.binding_basis: The six rendered titles match TP C01-C06 exactly. Upload order is reversed relative to card order, so every image is bound by title.

rejected_queue.reason: Its title sequence describes a different six-card plan and does not match the renders.

materiality_test.substantive_definition: A deviation is substantive when it can materially change the reader understanding of the finding, evidence weight, uncertainty, scope, provenance, causal boundary or decision ceiling.
materiality_test.presentation_only_handling: Record presentation-only deviations in historical_text_comparison; they do not block publication or alter the derived reader outcome.

audit_policy.content_truth_track: Before rendering, compare the proposed card content with the resolved primary PDF and check both factual accuracy and material omissions across the reader contract.
audit_policy.render_fidelity_track: After rendering, compare the image with the approved specification and reader contract. Paraphrase, abbreviation, layout labels and non-claim decoration pass unless they introduce a substantive error or misleading data geometry.
audit_policy.engineering_conformance_track: JSON exactness rules are purpose-scoped guardrails. A required object, relation, exact_once or unlisted-text deviation is blocking only when it protects substantive truth or source traceability and the deviation is material.
audit_policy.historical_text_comparison_track: Historical wording comparison records equivalent wording or wording divergence without pass/fail language and has zero weight in the science-communication verdict.
global_constraints_checked: no completed-public-release claim for the 4,978-record local collection
no use of 61.9% as RAG or end-to-end baseline performance
no averaging of strict joint success
no claim that every question is multi-paper
no evidence-state grading invented for evidence object classes

derived_reader_outcome.interpretation: C02 invents evidence-strength grades and C05 contradicts the reported venue distribution, distorting both the central account and evidence weight.

summary.interpretation: The pre-upload specification is source-aligned. C02 materially invents evidence grades for object classes, and C05 fabricates venue-chart geometry that contradicts the stated ICCV distribution.

cards.title: 答案對，不代表整條證據鏈都對
visible_text: 先找對論文
再定位可核對證據
最後才判答案是否正確
三段任一失敗，joint success 就不成立
Oracle paper／oracle evidence 是診斷階梯，不是成績排行榜。
標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
cards.main_visual_scene: A three-stage paper-to-evidence-to-answer pipeline ends in an AND gate, with oracle paper and oracle evidence diagnostic shortcuts alongside it.

differences: Unlisted text: 先放寬論文限制，測定位於錯在哪一步。
Unlisted text: 再放寬為 oracle 證據，確認是否為證據定位或核對問題。
Additional scene labels such as 論文庫, 證據物件 and 答案判定 are visible outside the authorised list.

cards.title: 證據不只是一段文字
visible_text: 公開開發集：55 題
五種主證據：表格、圖、文字、公式／演算法、引用脈絡
定位以 paper＋type＋page 為骨架；表格與圖再加 object ID
細到 row／column／region 的欄位可存在於標註，但不是所有 public scorer 都要求逐欄輸出。
cards.main_visual_scene: A paper is surrounded by five evidence-object icons, with a locator hierarchy for paper, type, page and object ID.
cards.targeted_audit: fail: evidence object classes are assigned fabricated 核心／推論／衝突 grades.
cards.required_correction: Remove all evidence-state badges from the five object types; keep only the object taxonomy and locator structure authorised by the card.

violations: The paper does not grade tables, figures and text as 核心, equations/algorithms as 推論, or citation context as 衝突.
The evidence-state legend applies to claim status in the rendering system, not to the intrinsic reliability of LitTraceQA evidence types.

differences: Unlisted 核心, 推論 and 衝突 labels are rendered repeatedly, along with separate object headings and diagram text.

cards.title: 規模很大，但先看清楚「是哪一批」
visible_text: 較大的本地標註集合：4978 題
multi-paper：64.85%
其餘仍包含 single-paper
本地集合使用 MC 與 structured table；public dev 另支援 free-form
這些不是「正式公開 benchmark 已全部完成」的宣告。
cards.main_visual_scene: Public development and the larger local collection appear as separate boxes; the local box separates multi-paper and single-paper content.

differences: Unlisted display labels such as 本地集合 and public dev repeat scene concepts outside the exact visible_text list.

cards.title: 這個 61.9%，最容易被讀錯
visible_text: 61.9%：三個 closed-book challengers 全部答錯
用途：篩掉靠模型記憶就能穩定猜中的題
它記錄的是建構時 hardness metadata
challenger 沒有 paper context；不能把這個比例當成 RAG 或 end-to-end baseline 失敗率。
cards.main_visual_scene: Three anonymised closed-book challengers connect to a construction funnel and a 61.9% hardness-metadata label rather than a leaderboard.

differences: Unlisted labels include 模型 A, 模型 B, 模型 C, 資料建構流程（示意）, 候選題蒐集, 品質檢核 and 難度評估.

cards.title: 大集合也有自己的偏斜
visible_text: ICCV：48.6% 的 gold-paper links
918 組 repeated gold-paper sets
72 筆只有不到兩個 evidence items
證據類型本身仍很多樣，不只 text span
這些是 corpus balance／release design 問題，不是說每一筆 QA 都錯。
cards.main_visual_scene: Unequal venue blocks show source imbalance, alongside repeated-set and evidence-count audit labels and a small evidence-diversity strip.
cards.targeted_audit: fail: the venue chart omits the dominant ICCV category and reverses source ranks.
cards.required_correction: Redraw venue blocks from the source ledger, including ICCV as the dominant category and preserving the correct relative order and proportions.

violations: ICCV, which accounts for 48.6% and is the dominant venue, is omitted from the chart despite appearing in adjacent text.
ACL is drawn highest although it is 10.7%; EMNLP is drawn second although it is 4.6%; NAACL at 11.3% should rank above both.
The chart geometry directly contradicts the source's Figure 4 and the card's own text.

differences: Unlisted venue labels and bar-like blocks create unauthorised quantitative encodings; the displayed ordering is also false.

cards.title: 作者自己也寫了：release 還沒收工
visible_text: 統一 evidence locator
定義 official public／hidden splits
交代 licensing／redistribution
補 human review／expert spot-check
用相同三段 metrics 跑 retrieval-augmented baselines
現在最準確的定位：benchmark-development paper＋public dev，而不是已完成全部 release governance。
cards.main_visual_scene: An unfinished release checklist is paired with the paper-to-evidence-to-answer evaluation line.

differences: Unlisted scene text includes Release Checklist and the lower paper, evidence and answer labels.

reader_contract.central_claim: LitTraceQA describes a method and local corpus for evaluating multi-paper literature question answering with structured evidence tracing, but the public benchmark, validation, governance and retrieval-augmented baselines are not yet complete.
reader_contract.evidence_weight: The paper defines a benchmark-development method and reports self-audited corpus statistics; external validation and release governance remain incomplete.
reader_contract.limitations: Locator normalisation, official splits, licensing, human review and retrieval-augmented baselines remain unfinished.
reader_contract.applicability: The local collection and public development split have different sizes and answer formats.
reader_contract.misuse_boundaries: Hardness metadata describes closed-book construction filtering, not end-to-end or RAG performance. Do not advertise a completed public benchmark or invent evidence-strength grades for evidence object types.
